items.name: Frail
items.description: Gains 25% less Block from abilities (rounded half-up).

items.name: Taunt
items.description: Forces the player to target this enemy.

items.name: Block
items.description: Absorbs incoming damage. Expires at the owner's next round start.

items.name: Strength
items.description: Adds bonus damage to every hit.

items.name: Mark
items.description: Marked by Ace. Cash In removes a Mark for a bonus effect. Marks persist until cashed in.
